usageNotes: Use to move an LXC container to a different node within the same PVE cluster managed by a PDM remote; the caller must hold Resource.Migrate on the guest. The operation is asynchronous — the response is a remote UPID that must be polled for completion. For a running container, set 'online' for live migration (lower downtime) or 'restart' for a stop-start migration (broader storage compatibility); leaving both false will fail if the container is running.

examples.summary: Online-migrate a running LXC (VMID 201) from pve-remote to node pve-node-02

destructiveReason: The container is moved off its current node; if the migration fails mid-transfer the container may be left in a stopped or inconsistent state on the source or target node.
tips: Poll the returned UPID via the PDM task-status endpoint to detect completion or failure before assuming success.
Use 'target-storage' when source and target nodes do not share the same storage pool names — omitting it may cause the migration to fail if storage IDs differ.
restart-migration (restart: true) is the safer fallback for containers with local storage that cannot be live-migrated.
Set bwlimit to avoid saturating cluster links during business hours; 0 means unlimited.
The 'node' body parameter specifies the current node if PDM cannot infer it; 'target' is the destination and is always required.
